B (abstract complete Riemannian ℝⁿ-manifolds, Setup16, a < c, Ω^a ≠ ∅): B^a non-empty and COMPACT (Milnor's d-topology), E attains its minimum on B^a at γ, and γ is a minimal geodesic (length ≤ that of every piecewise smooth path on any interval) from p to q.
